items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Herbie got to the date early and appropriated all the solos. I was too new in the business and unsure of what my position was supposed to be. So I didn‟t correct it.

ctx.x: Plus, I wrote all the solos for Richie. Herbie got to the date early and appropriated all the solos. I was too new in the business and unsure of what my position was supposed to be. So I didn‟t correct it. Live and learn, huh?
I just want to briefly return to The Fabulous Bill Holman, the title of that album. I can‟t imagine that that was something that you chose, but perhaps you can set the record straight on that.
